value.rationale: The source uses explicit local bounds to select feasible nonlinear TVD point updates. The sharp criterion raises its certified Courant budget by approximately 8%-20% depending on wave-speed contrast, identifies an exact contrast threshold of 1/6, and yields an implementable slope-dependent bound, without extra nonlinear speed solving. This is a substantive, motivated sharp discretization cutoff for the published sufficient interval, not a universal solver stability claim.
